claims.claim_text: LOGCAP V Kuwait Task Order contributed $441.6M of revenue in FY2025 (9.9% of total revenue), down slightly from $450.3M (10.4%) in FY2024 and 12.0% in FY2023. Current PoP exercised through June 30, 2026, with possible extension to June 2030.

LOGCAP V IDIQ contract vehicle: V2X is one of four prime awardees; the aggregate LOGCAP V vehicle (Kuwait, Iraq, INDOPACOM and other task orders) represents the company's largest contract relationship. The Kuwait TO award was approximately $2.9B with estimated completion December 2026.

Warfighter Training Readiness Solutions (WTRS) Program is the Army's largest support and services program for worldwide training systems sustainment; V2X performs as a sole-source task order under the ASTRO IDIQ contract.

T-45 Goshawk trainer aircraft program: V2X provides Navy and Marine organizational, intermediate, and depot-level maintenance, sustainment, and life-extension services across 29 unique configurations.

Customer mix: substantial majority of FY2025 revenue derived from U.S. Government customers; specifically, approximately 41% of FY2025 total revenue (43% in FY2024, 41% in FY2023) came from the U.S. Army.
U.S. Government contracts performed internationally represented approximately 42% of total revenue for FY2025; operations span 349 locations in 49 countries.

Total backlog of $11.1B as of December 31, 2025 ($2.3B funded, $8.8B unfunded); backlog decreased by $1.4B YoY primarily due to timing of new awards offset by revenue recognition. FY2025 funded orders of $4.5B (+$0.7B YoY).

FY2025 revenue of $4,480.0M (+3.7% YoY), operating income $194.3M (4.3% margin, +60 bps), net income $77.9M; workforce of approximately 16,200 employees with ~30% represented by 60 collective bargaining agreements.

Defense logistics/operational support cohort positioning: LOGCAP V (Kuwait + INDOPACOM TOs), WTRS under ASTRO, and T-45 Goshawk depot maintenance constitute V2X's headline named programs. Each ties to an ongoing OP-5 SAG line item (Base Operations Support, Training Support, Aircraft Depot Maintenance).
